title: Drill 11: Drug Administration - Training ID 9
description: To refresh the DMT’s fading knowledge in the different routes for Drug Administration
objectives: To refresh the DMT’s fading knowledge in the different routes for Drug Administration

The participants will be able to discuss the different routes for Drug Administration Discuss basic relevant anatomy of the body involved in the different routes of Drug Administration Discuss the principles and procedure for IM injections, subcutaneous injections and rectal drug administration
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.
